summary: A sign up app for the gaming team 'Savage Elite' with an integrated merch shop
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Savage Elite gaming team logo with aggressive, competitive styling featuring sharp edges and bold typography (savage-elite-logo.dim_512x512.png)
- Gaming t-shirt mockup with Savage Elite branding on black fabric (merch-tshirt.dim_800x800.png)
- Gaming hoodie mockup with Savage Elite logo on dark fabric (merch-hoodie.dim_800x800.png)
- Gaming mouse pad with Savage Elite design and vibrant colors (merch-mousepad.dim_800x800.png)
- Gaming cap/hat mockup with Savage Elite embroidered logo (merch-cap.dim_800x800.png)

existing_features.title: Create a team signup form that collects gamer tag, email, preferred game role, and experience level for joining Savage Elite gaming team
Build a merch shop displaying Savage Elite branded products with product images, names, descriptions, and prices
Implement shopping cart functionality allowing users to add merch items, view cart contents, and adjust quantities
Create an admin interface to manage team member signups and view submitted applications
Design a bold, gaming-focused visual theme with aggressive colors (blacks, reds, neon accents) and edgy typography that reflects the 'Savage Elite' brand identity consistently across all pages
Display generated Savage Elite logo and merch product images as static assets from frontend/public/assets/generated
